Rinnai Infinity B26 Continuous Flow Gas Hot Water System

SKU 7394Instant Gas50° modelIn stock

The B26 is a cost-effective continuous flow gas hot water system that has been popular with building professionals for decades. They are compact, engineered to last and have a 6-star energy rating.

The B26's reliability means it probably has been installed in more Sydney units and townhouses than any other brand. It heats water on demand, so there is no tank to run out and nothing kept hot overnight.

Delivery areas

We deliver hot water systems, parts and accessories across New South Wales and to selected areas throughout Australia. Availability can vary with your postcode and the size of the product, so contact us first if you are outside the standard delivery area.

Delivery timeframes

Estimates only, and they can be affected by courier delays, weather or other events outside our control.

  • Sydney metro: 1 to 3 business days
  • Regional NSW: 2 to 7 business days
  • Interstate: 3 to 10 business days

Delivery charges

Shipping is calculated at checkout from your delivery location, the size and weight of the product, and any installation requirements. Some products and promotional offers include free delivery within selected metro areas.

Installation deliveries

Where installation is booked with your purchase, our team contacts you to arrange a date and time once the order is confirmed. Scheduling depends on technician availability and your location.

On arrival

Please inspect your order when it arrives. If it looks damaged, incomplete or incorrect, tell us within 48 hours and include photographs where you can.

Returns

We comply with the Australian Consumer Law. Nothing here limits your rights under the Competition and Consumer Act 2010 (Cth).

Change of mind returns may be accepted at our discretion when the request is made within 30 days of delivery, the product has not been installed or used, it remains unopened in its original packaging and it is in resalable condition. Return shipping for approved change of mind returns is generally the customer's responsibility. Special order and custom products cannot be returned for change of mind.

If a product is faulty, damaged or not as described, contact us as soon as you can. Depending on the circumstances we may repair it, replace it, provide a refund or arrange collection. If you receive the wrong product, contact us within 48 hours and we will arrange a replacement or collection at no extra cost where the error is ours.

How to request a return

Contact our team with your order details, explain the reason, send photographs if we ask for them, and wait for return instructions before sending anything back. Returns sent without prior approval may not be accepted. Approved refunds go back to the original payment method, usually within 5 to 10 business days of the return being received and inspected.

Full terms are on the shipping and return policy page.

A continuous flow unit has no tank and no anode to replace, so care is mostly about keeping it clear and checking it still runs the way it should.

  • Keep the area around the unit clear so air can move freely and the flue is not obstructed.
  • Keep the filter at the cold water inlet clean, particularly if the supply carries sediment.
  • Have the gas and water connections checked by a licensed technician if you notice a change in temperature, flow or ignition.
  • Note any error code shown on the display before you call, because it points straight at the fault.
  • Book a service if the unit is cycling, taking longer to reach temperature or dropping temperature when a second tap opens.

If something is not right, our phone line is attended 24 hours on 1300 096 668.

How it works

From first call to hot water back on

The same four steps apply whether you are replacing a failed unit or planning an upgrade.

  1. Tell us what is happening

    Call or order online with your suburb and the system you have now. Photos of the unit and its data plate help a great deal.

  2. We scope and quote

    We confirm the model, the installation and any extras the site needs, then come back to you before anything is booked.

  3. We supply and install

    We bring the unit, disconnect the old system, install and commission the new one, and check the valves are working as they should.

  4. We clear the site

    The old unit is taken away where you have asked us to, the work is tested in front of you, and you get the paperwork and warranty details.

Common questions

Rinnai B26 questions

The B26 suits most units, townhouses and smaller homes. Where a household runs several showers at once, or the kitchen and laundry are in use at the same time, a larger continuous flow unit may be the better choice. Tell us how many bathrooms you have and how the hot water gets used and we will confirm it before you order.

It is the same unit with a different pre-set delivery temperature. The 50° model is temperature limited for extra safety, which suits homes with young children. The 60° model delivers hotter water for the kitchen and laundry, and is normally paired with a tempering valve on the outlets that serve bathrooms.

No. This model is an external use only unit and mounts on an outside wall. If the only practical position is internal, we will look at a model built for that instead rather than fit this one somewhere it does not belong.

Either. The price on this page is the unit on its own, and installation is an option you tick or leave off. Most customers take it, because one licensed team then handles the quote, the unit, the fit-off and the removal of the old system, so you are not managing a supplier and an installer separately. If you have your own plumber, order the unit by itself.

The valve kit is mandatory on instantaneous gas systems, so it applies to this unit. The rest depend on the site: removal of the old unit, an isolation valve, a pressure limiting valve where mains pressure runs high, or pipework changes where the position or model has changed. If you are not sure, order with what you know and we will confirm the final list with you before any work is booked.
